summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RBAC notification fixes, alert configuration, and RnD photo lifecycle. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend notification bell, preferences dialog, and alert threshold configuration verified.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/notifications/categories returns 'personal' category for HR and Finance users
Backend: Category totals match categorized items count (no phantom counts)
Backend: GET /api/notifications/my-category-prefs returns locked_categories with 'personal'
Backend: PUT my-category-prefs silently drops 'personal' from muted_categories
Backend: Muted category disappears from categorized list, unmuting restores it
Backend: GET /api/rahaza/management/alert-config returns all 4 thresholds (po_warn_days, ar_warn_days, rnd_attention_days, rnd_stale_days)
Backend: PUT alert-config with valid values returns 200
Backend: PUT alert-config with attention > stale returns 400 with Indonesian error message
Backend: PUT alert-config with value > 60 returns 400
Backend: PUT alert-config with value < 0 returns 400
Backend: PUT alert-config as HR returns 403 (permission check)
Backend: GET /api/dewi/rnd/approvals/pending returns thresholds object with attention_days, stale_days, source
Backend: POST /api/dewi/rnd/styles/{id}/images uploads photo and returns url starting with /api/files/
Backend: GET file with Authorization header returns 200 image/*
Backend: GET file with ?auth=jwt returns 200 (browser support)
Backend: GET file without credentials returns 401
Backend: GET file with forged JWT returns 401 (security fix verified - no longer accepts verify_signature=False)
Backend: DELETE /api/dewi/rnd/styles/{id}/images/{img_id} removes photo
Backend: 12 valid logins succeed (rate limit tier raised to 30/60s)
Backend: Brute-force protection still works (6 wrong passwords trigger lockout)
Regression: POC RBAC script passes 57/57 tests (notification isolation, personal category, muting, approval gates)
Frontend: Notification bell found and clickable in Portal Manajemen
Frontend: Notification bell dropdown opens with category chips
Frontend: Gear button (preferences) found in bell dropdown
Frontend: Notification preferences dialog opens (data-testid=notif-prefs-dialog)
Frontend: 'Untuk Saya' category shows 'selalu aktif' lock indicator in preferences dialog
Frontend: Alert threshold form found with 4 number inputs (PO, Piutang, RnD kuning, RnD merah)
Frontend: Alert threshold values can be changed and saved
Frontend: Success toast shown after saving thresholds
Frontend: RnD summary page shows updated threshold sentence (kuning ≥ 2 hari · merah ≥ 5 hari)
Frontend: Invalid threshold input (attention > stale) shows error message
Frontend: Original threshold values restored successfully
